mission: Red-team stroke classification with ambiguous motions (practice swings, aborted strokes, hybrid motions, non-dominant hand, wheelchair play) via the real code path; force confidently-wrong L1/L2/L3 outputs; regression fixture + root cause for each.

attacked: packages/vision-geometry/src/strokeHeuristicLite.ts (byte-equivalent mobile port — parity of every finding verified by direct execution)
codePath.method: Synthetic adversarial pose sequences (provenance-stamped, @pickle/evaluation) fed directly into classifyStroke; outputs measured, not asserted. No held-out case was viewed or touched (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1 untouched).

datasetScope: Synthetic adversarial fixtures only (6 new, deterministic). No human data, no gold labels, no run dirs touched. Fixtures are labeled synthetic and cannot satisfy release eligibility.

findings.groundTruth: not a stroke (ball-less shadow swing, reference is motion peak)
findings.rootCause: reference_is_event_peak_not_contact is recorded as a limiting factor but never gates commitment or caps L2 confidence; no ball/contact evidence is required anywhere in the hierarchy to assert a stroke identity.

findings.groundTruth: left-hand forehand by a declared right-handed player
findings.measuredOutput: BACKHAND depth 2 confidence 0.80 (both copies) — mirrored side
findings.rootCause: Side decision uses declared handedness only; the measured dominant-motion wrist side (left, from dominantWristInfo) contradicts the declaration and is never cross-checked.

findings.groundTruth: side not measurable (image-plane shoulder width 0.005u; midline offset 0.0075u = noise scale)
findings.rootCause: shoulderWidth is floored at 0.02 and used as the side-margin normalization base with no degeneracy gate (torso extent has TORSO_MIN_EXTENT; shoulder width has no analog). 0.0075u becomes 0.38 shoulder-widths, clearing SIDE_MARGIN_FLOOR 0.15.

findings.groundTruth: FOREHAND (rear view every frame; torso rotation crosses shoulders past profile at the contact frame only)
findings.measuredOutput: BACKHAND depth 2 confidence 0.80 with evidence 'front-ish view' (both copies)
findings.rootCause: Facing sign is derived from the shoulder x-order of the single nearest frame; mid-swing rotation at that instant inverts it and mirrors the side call at full confidence. No multi-frame facing consensus, no small-shoulder-separation guard.

findings.groundTruth: not a stroke (symmetric bimanual wheelchair rim propulsion, 0.9 u/s, hip height)
findings.rootCause: Non-stroke gates test only single-dominant-wrist energy (floor 0.25 u/s) and travel (floor 0.05u); symmetric two-arm motion — the signature of rim propulsion — has no discriminator.

defensesHeld.attack: fast backswing pull (1.0 u/s window peak, defeating the energy gate) checked before the reference

artifacts.fixtures: packages/evaluation/src/synthetic/adversarialStrokeFixtures.ts (append-only: practiceShadowSwingFixture, nonDominantHandSwingFixture, profileViewCollapsedShouldersFixture, facingFlipAtContactFixture, wheelchairRimPushFixture, energeticAbortedSwingFixture)
artifacts.tests: packages/swing-lab/test/strokeHeuristicAmbiguous.redteam.test.ts (5 pinned open findings + 2 defense guards; pins assert the CURRENT wrong output so a classifier fix must flip them consciously)

boundaryNotes: Classifier code NOT modified (outside e10 ownership; lite/lab copies additionally require paired changes + calibration per strokeHeuristicLite.ts header). Findings are pinned characterization tests + forensic root causes for a follow-up calibration wave. Predictions were never relabeled as observations; no thresholds or contracts were altered.
